prompt: Wide 16:9 clean product illustration for a premium light-mode website card. Create a crisp diagram-style audit-output visual, not a metaphor poster. White/off-white background, navy outline strokes, Stanley green accents, very pale mint fills. Composition: central structured audit board / workflow diagram with four clean rounded nodes arranged in a simple 2x2 or flow layout. The four nodes represent delayed invoice, open estimate, missed call, and inactive customer / missed follow-up using simple abstract icons only, no words or letters. One node is highlighted with a Stanley green outline and a small green leak indicator flowing out of a workflow connector, showing a business-process leak, not plumbing. A small magnifying glass may point at the highlighted node but must not dominate. Use simple geometric connectors, check/alert dots, clean whitespace, no clutter. Designed Figma-style vector asset, crisp edges, no texture, no noise, no painterly shading, no stock illustration feel. No people, no robots, no AI motifs. No readable labels, no numbers, no metric cards, no CTA buttons, no full website screenshot. Strict palette only: white, off-white, navy, slate gray, Stanley green, pale mint. No orange, no amber, no yellow, no gold, no tan, no beige wash, no sepia, no black background, no dark-mode scene, no purple glow.
